meta.name: vad-team-map20-v17
meta.description: VAD agent team v17 — implement + adjudicate CNV (Cascade Null-Hypothesis Veto), the owner-directed ORIGINAL mechanism for NORMAL-video false positives, as a confidence-veto at the terminal slot, measured by the PROVEN paired-log conf-mode bootstrap (exact paired, zero VLM noise), with the mAP floor as a NON-INFERIORITY constraint and the normal-video false-alarm rate as the PRIMARY objective. Committed pipeline = v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal (all default-ON, full-290 ~0.173, v160_full 0.17254; hard-88 ~0.11806). v16 CLOSED the entire candidate-RELOCATION family (CGR-M exact-paired -0.00487, P=0.224; CLIP-curve relocation died 3x before) and left the dual-arm rig in the tree. CNV rationale (owner session 2026-08-14): the pipeline has ONLY segment-level decisions and no video-level null hypothesis; VLM absolute confidence on isolated clips is uncalibrated (v143 root cause). CNV = ONE-SIDED veto (only removes confidence, never adds/moves): STAGE 1 video-level global-null gate — veto ALL of a video's detections iff THREE independent cached signal families are ALL negative (MIL top-k snippet mean low AND fused CLIP category curve in-video max-z low AND motion-energy outlier fraction low); STAGE 2 segment-level in-video surprisal veto — on surviving videos, veto any detection whose window curve mass is NOT an outlier vs its own video baseline. Thresholds are PRINCIPLED STRUCTURAL DEFAULTS verified (NOT fitted) on a few TRAIN videos — no test-set tuning. Veto = set confidence to 0.0 and keep the detection (count-frozen, index-aligned), logged as [CNV-FIRE] marker lines conf=old->new so analysis_bootstrap_ab.py --paired-log --paired-mode conf restores the arm-OFF arm EXACTLY (the v138/v139 proven path — NO new bootstrap code, NO models.py change). Oracle context (v9): deleting every Normal-video FP is worth only +0.00253 mAP, so mAP is the CONSTRAINT (paired delta >= -0.003, abs >= REF290-0.008), the OBJECTIVE is the false-alarm rate (>= 25% relative reduction in Normal-video FA rate, <= 1 GT-overlapping detection vetoed). ONE conditional structural variant (v172): tighten (add VideoMAE==Normal as 4th conjunct) if harm, loosen (2-of-3 conjunct) if the gate under-fires — never numeric test-fitting. Ends with a C-reviewed DESIGN-ONLY deliverable (no eval) for the next signal-quality lever (Shoplifting cand-miss / flat curves) as v173 input. Concurrency 2. NONE of the 10 banned families; relocation family CLOSED; Normal-FP-for-mAP stays banned — CNV is judged on the FA-rate objective with mAP only as constraint.
